units.translation: Correctly αἱρετώτερος [more preferable] in Menander's monostich 193: about which I should have noted under αἱρετός [preferable].
death is a more ready resource than a wretched life
pleasant to drink, from which it is sweet to drink
and the sweet stream of Cenchreae
where from the Bybline mountains the Nile sends forth its holy, sweet stream
for obedience is the mother of prosperity, of a saving offspring

which Wellauer thought should be written εὐ πρᾶξις [good success], as at line 500 it is said εὐ γὰρ πρὸς εὐ φανεῖσι προσθήκη πελοι. εὔπραξις [for to those who appear good, good is an addition]. If εὔπραξις [success] is correctly written, similar compounds can be compared, as noted in Thes. vol. 3 p. 2267.
for to those who appear good, good is an addition. success
Ag. 1428 corruptly for ἐμπρέπει [it is fitting], which see.
Corruptly εὐπρεπής [comely] or εὐτρεπής [ready]. See λευκοπρεπής [white-looking].
let her come forth – a woman as ruler, but a man more comely
and all the allied force is conspicuous
she spoke her speech thus becomingly
well-steering in the grace of the mind
to the streams of the Euripus
the stranger seems to be keen-scented, like a dog
(in the past tenses in M constantly written without augment εὑρ [found], I added the augment restoring ηύρ- [found]: about which see what L. Dindorf said in Thes. vol. 3 p. 2420) I find
Middle form εὑρίσκομαι [I find for myself] I procure for myself, I contract
Thus Porson for εὐ ῥέοντα [flowing well].
for he is clever at finding resources even from impossibilities
what remedy for this disease have you found?
he found linen-winged vehicles for sailors
you cannot find with what medicines you are curable
why did you yoke her to these, having found her erring in misfortunes?
he will find a flame stronger than lightning
he found a device of safety
having found some means of escape
and my son found a bitter vengeance for famous Athens
may he find a faithful wife in his house when he comes
and I shall find him on his father's throne
you will never find a drink
you find the path of a good tongue
so that we may find the altars of the city-protecting gods before the temple
and they will find many well-filed
finding my lost things I bring them
but you will find the inhabitants of this land to be men
now the source of evils seems to have been found for all friends
he once found a memory as recompense in prayers
